zh.title: 从你现在这一步开始。
zh.intro: 第一次设置，从电脑开始。家里已经准备好了，就拿起手机扫码加入。
zh.desktopTitle: 你家里用的是哪种电脑？
zh.desktopText: 电脑负责保存照片。请在准备存照片的电脑上打开本页，并预留足够的硬盘空间。
zh.copied: 已复制。回到刚才打开的窗口，粘贴并按回车。
zh.copyFailed: 请选中上方完整命令，手动复制。
zh.help: 遇到问题？查看详细帮助

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.openTitle: 打开安装用的命令窗口
platforms.openText: 按 Win + R，输入 cmd，然后按回车。只需复制下一步的命令，无需输入管理员密码。
platforms.pasteTitle: 复制下面这条命令，粘贴后按回车
platforms.finishTitle: 等待电脑自动打开设置网页
platforms.finishText: 安装完成会启动 Lomorage，并打开设置网页。第一次使用时，保留网页上的设置二维码，下一步用手机应用扫描。以后可搜索 Lomorage 再次打开。
platforms.detailNote: 适用于 Windows x64 电脑。安装期间需要联网；不必反复粘贴命令。

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.openText: 按 Command + 空格，搜索“终端”并打开。不需要输入管理员密码。
platforms.pasteTitle: 复制下面这条命令，粘贴后按回车
platforms.finishTitle: 等待电脑自动打开设置网页
platforms.finishText: 安装完成会启动 Lomorage，并打开设置网页。第一次使用时，保留网页上的设置二维码，下一步用手机应用扫描。以后可搜索 Lomorage 再次打开。
platforms.detailNote: 支持 Apple 芯片和 Intel Mac，无需另外安装 Python 或开发工具。安装期间请保持联网。

zh.phoneTitle: 接着，在手机上装好应用。
zh.phoneText: 用手机点击下载按钮，或用系统相机扫描下方的下载二维码。连接电脑时，请使用 LomoMobile 应用里的扫码功能。
zh.phoneBack: 第一次设置，还没安装电脑端？从这里开始
zh.connectTitle: 扫一扫，让照片找到自己的家。

connectSteps.title: 手机和电脑连到同一家庭网络
connectSteps.text: 保持电脑上的 Lomorage 开着。首次安装后，电脑设置网页会显示一个设置二维码。

connectSteps.title: 在 LomoMobile 里打开相机扫码
connectSteps.text: 第一次设置：扫描电脑上的设置码，确认连接后创建账号、选择存储位置。家里已有账号：扫描为你准备的登录码即可。

connectSteps.title: 允许照片访问，查看备份进度
connectSteps.text: 按提示允许访问想备份的照片。先确认几张照片已备份、能正常打开，再熟悉自动备份设置。

zh.connectionQuestion: 手机里没有找到电脑，怎么办？
zh.connectionAnswer: 先用 LomoMobile 应用里的扫码功能，扫描电脑设置页上的二维码；家里已有账号，可请家人展示你的登录码。扫码会带入连接地址，不需要依赖自动发现。若仍连不上，请确认两台设备在同一家庭网络、电脑上的 Lomorage 已启动。手动填写地址和防火墙排查请查看详细帮助。
zh.connectionHelp: 需要帮忙连接？联系我们
zh.optionalNote: 第一次备份手机照片，可以先跳过这里。
zh.importTitle: 把旧硬盘里的照片也整理进来
zh.importText: 电脑端和手机账号准备好后，下载导入工具。解压打开，使用已有账号登录，选择照片文件夹，再开始导入。
zh.importHelp: 查看文件夹与 USB 导入说明
zh.otherText: NAS、树莓派和 Linux 的安装入口在下方“其他设备”区域。
zh.otherLink: 查看其他设备安装说明
zh.supportLink: 告诉我们你使用的电脑和手机
zh.devicesTitle: 已经有 NAS？也可以把照片存在那里。
zh.devicesText: 如果你熟悉 NAS、树莓派或家用服务器，可按对应指南安装。用电脑开始的家庭可以跳过这里。
zh.devicesAll: 查看所有平台与安装要求
zh.setupChoiceLabel: 选择适合你的安装步骤
zh.newSetupText: 先准备电脑，再连接手机
zh.existingSetupText: 下载手机应用，扫描登录码

en.title: Start where you are.
en.intro: Setting up for the first time? Begin on your computer. Already set up at home? Get the phone app and scan to join.
en.desktopTitle: Which computer do you use at home?
en.desktopText: Your computer stores the photos. Open this page on that computer and make sure it has enough free disk space.
en.copied: Copied. Return to the window you opened, paste, and press Enter.
en.copyFailed: Select the full command above and copy it manually.
en.help: Having trouble? Read the detailed guide

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.openText: Press Win + R, type cmd, and press Enter. You only need to copy the command below; no administrator password is needed.
platforms.pasteTitle: Copy the command, paste it, and press Enter
platforms.finishTitle: Wait for the setup page to open
platforms.finishText: Installation starts Lomorage and opens its setup page. For a first setup, keep the QR code on screen to scan with the phone app next. Later, search for Lomorage to reopen it.
platforms.detailNote: For Windows x64 computers. Stay connected to the internet during installation; there is no need to paste the command again.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.openText: Press Command + Space, search for Terminal, and open it. You do not need an administrator password.
platforms.pasteTitle: Copy the command, paste it, and press Enter
platforms.finishTitle: Wait for the setup page to open
platforms.finishText: Installation starts Lomorage and opens its setup page. For a first setup, keep the QR code on screen to scan with the phone app next. Later, search for Lomorage to reopen it.
platforms.detailNote: Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. No separate Python or developer tools installation is needed. Stay connected to the internet during installation.

en.phoneTitle: Next, get the app on your phone.
en.phoneText: Tap a download button on your phone, or scan a download code below with its camera. To connect to your computer afterward, use the scanner inside LomoMobile.
en.phoneBack: First setup, and your computer isn’t ready? Start here
en.iosButton: Get it on the App Store
en.iosNote: Look for LomoMobile in the store
en.connectTitle: Scan a code. Give your photos a home.

connectSteps.title: Join the same home network
connectSteps.text: Keep Lomorage running on the computer. After a fresh installation, its setup page shows a setup QR code.

connectSteps.title: Open the scanner inside LomoMobile
connectSteps.text: First setup: scan the computer’s setup code, confirm the connection, then create an account and choose storage. Account already prepared? Scan your sign-in code instead.

connectSteps.title: Allow photo access and check your backup
connectSteps.text: Allow access to the photos you want to back up. Check that a few photos are backed up and open correctly, then explore automatic backup settings.

en.connectionQuestion: My phone can’t find my computer. What next?
en.connectionAnswer: Use the scanner inside LomoMobile to scan the computer’s setup code. If an account is already prepared, ask for your sign-in code. Scanning fills in the connection address without automatic discovery. If connection still fails, check that both devices are on the same home network and Lomorage is running. See the detailed guide for manual addresses and firewall troubleshooting.
en.optionalTitle: Have photos on an older drive?
en.optionalNote: You can skip this for your first phone backup.
en.importTitle: Bring photos from an existing hard drive
en.importText: Once your computer and phone account are set up, download the importer. Extract and open it, sign in with your existing account, select a photo folder, and start importing.
en.importHelp: Read the folder & USB import guide
en.otherText: Find NAS, Raspberry Pi and Linux guides in “Other devices” below.
en.supportNote: Not sure what to do next?
en.supportLink: Tell us which computer and phone you use
en.devicesTitle: Already have a NAS? Your photos can live there.
en.devicesText: If you use a NAS, Raspberry Pi or home server, follow its setup guide. Families starting with a computer can skip this section.
en.newSetupText: Prepare your computer, then connect your phone
en.existingSetupText: Get the phone app and scan your sign-in code
